the effectiveness of feed additives is not well established and further studies are required to evaluate their true efficacy.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of feed additives in pig diets can improve gut health and productivity.
there is a need for a standard challenge model and response criteria for evaluating feed additives for the improvement of gut health in pigs.
the use of zinc oxide, copper sulfate, spray dried porcide plasma, egg yolk antibody and mannan-oligosaccharides have all shown to be effective in enhancing gut health of pigs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the effectiveness of feed additives in enhancing gut health and performance of pigs is highly dependent on the challenge model used and the criteria used to assess the response to the challenge model.
there are no single additive which can be used to replace the use of in-feed antibiotics in pig diets.
, the effectiveness of these feed additives should not be judged solely based on the results of a challenge model.
